title: Practice 9: за and под: going behind, under

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Его бросили в тюрьму за ___ (грабёж, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: He was thrown in prison for robbery.
exercises.why: **грабёж → грабёж** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. грабёж · грабежа · грабежу · грабёж · грабежом · грабеже; pl. грабежи · грабежей · грабежам · грабежи · грабежами · грабежах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Под ___ (надзор, acc. sg.) сюда?
exercises.why: **надзор → надзор** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. надзор · надзора · надзору · надзор · надзором · надзоре; pl. надзоры · надзоров · надзорам · надзоры · надзорами · надзорах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том уцепился за ___ (ветка, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **ветка → ветку** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. ветка · ветки · ветке · ветку · веткой · ветке; pl. ветки · веток · веткам · ветки · ветками · ветках.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том выступал за ___ (прерывание, acc. sg.) миссии.
exercises.prompt: Tom was in favor of aborting the mission.
exercises.why: **прерывание → прерывание** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -ие. Declines like DLI's здание — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. здание). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. прерывание · прерывания · прерыванию · прерывание · прерыванием · прерывании; pl. прерывания · прерываний · прерываниям · прерывания · прерываниями · прерываниях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. exercises.q: А шерсть свиную хотите под ___ (ноготь, acc. pl.)?
exercises.why: **ноготь → ногти** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural ногти. Declines like DLI's автомобиль — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. автомобили). Ending -ь → -и, with the fleeting -о- of the stem dropped: ногт- + -и.  Declension: sg. ноготь · ногтя · ногтю · ноготь · ногтем · ногте; pl. ногти · ногтей · ногтям · ногти · ногтями · ногтях.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том мог бы сойти за ___ (тинейджер, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom could pass for a teenager.
exercises.why: **тинейджер → тинейджера** (acc. sg.). Masculine, animate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's студент — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. студента). Ending — (no ending) → -а.  Declension: sg. тинейджер · тинейджера · тинейджеру · тинейджера · тинейджером · тинейджере; pl. тинейджеры · тинейджеров · тинейджерам · тинейджеров · тинейджерами · тинейджерах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Шла рота солдат, несла знамя, барабаны били под ___ (знамя, acc. pl.).
exercises.why: **знамя → знамена** (acc. pl.). Neuter, inanimate; nominative plural знамёна. Declines like DLI's имя — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. имена). Ending -я → -ена.  Declension: sg. знамя · знамени · знамени · знамя · знаменем · знамени; pl. знамёна · знамён · знамёнам · знамёна · знамёнами · знамёнах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

Declension: sg. вторжение · вторжения · вторжению · вторжение · вторжением · вторжении; pl. вторжения · вторжений · вторжениям · вторжения · вторжениями · вторжениях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. exercises.q: Я испугался и сел под ___ (большой дуб, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **дуб → дуб** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **большой → большой** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with дуб). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русский (every form has the same endings, apart from the masculine nominative singular (and the inanimate accusative equal to it), which ends in -ой here, not -ий): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. дуб · дуба · дубу · дуб · дубом · дубе; pl. дубы · дубов · дубам · дубы · дубами · дубах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.» «The adjective «большой» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its -ш-: большого, большому, большим, о большом.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Под ___ (жужжание, acc. sg.) вентиляции и секретаря он о чем-то думал.
exercises.why: **жужжание → жужжанье** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -ие. Declines like DLI's здание — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. здание). The form changes by more than its ending, so no single ending is given — see the declension below.  Declension: sg. жужжание · жужжания · жужжанию · жужжание · жужжанием · жужжании; pl. жужжания · жужжаний · жужжаниям · жужжания · жужжаниями · жужжаниях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Берите профессора под ___ (жабра, acc. pl.) и сажайте на извозчика!
exercises.why: **жабра → жабры** (acc. pl.). Feminine, inanimate; nominative plural жабры. Declines like DLI's газета — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. газеты). Ending -а → -ы.  Declension: sg. жабра · жабры · жабре · жабру · жаброй · жабре; pl. жабры · жабр · жабрам · жабры · жабрами · жабрах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural.
